site.name: Rupeek B2C Gold Loan — LP2 Fresh

flow.name: Auth — phone and consent
flow.notes: Consent is checked by default on PhoneStep — do not toggle the custom checkbox

flow.name: Auth — pincode
flow.notes: Auth modal stays on /lp/b2c/2 — confirm-details screen does not change URL until later steps

flow.name: Confirm PAN details
flow.notes: Manual PAN fallback: fill Enter PAN number with {{credentials.pan}}, click Continue. Heading fallback: Is this you?

flow.name: Loan type — Fresh
flow.notes: Step 5 already lands on loan-type/v1 — do not navigate again

flow.name: Gold weight and primary preference

actions.label: Select button on Lowest Interest Rate preference card
Show My Offers button on gold weight page

flow.notes: Loan Amount tab is pre-selected with default ₹5,00,000 on page load — do not re-click the card or fill amount (re-click resets to ₹0). Show My Offers is a div-styled button, not a native button tag. After clicking it, wait for offer page — URL updates from gold-weight-details to offer-page.

flow.name: Feature preference
flow.notes: Skipped when step 7 selects a preference — Show My Offers routes directly to offer page, bypassing feature-preference

flow.name: Select offer
flow.notes: Proceed on offer page routes directly to meeting-slots — loan-summary is skipped in LP2 fresh flow. Do not navigate again.

flow.name: Loan summary
flow.notes: Skipped — LP2 fresh flow bypasses loan-summary; Proceed on offer page lands directly on meeting-slots

flow.name: Book meeting slot

actions.label: First available date on meeting slots calendar
First available Morning or Afternoon time slot on selected date

flow.notes: No-slots fallback: if the selected date shows no Morning/Afternoon time slots, click the next available date in the calendar and select the first available slot — repeat for up to 3 dates. If no date has slots, use emergency booking: click 'Need an emergency slot?', select the first slot in 'Choose Emergency Slots' popup, click 'Book Emergency Slot'. Do not click Continue until a time slot is selected.

flow.name: Booking confirmed — thank you

assertions.label: Our representative will reach out to you shortly to assist you further.

flow.notes: Previous step lands on thank-you — do not navigate again

errorCases.name: Invalid phone — not 10 digits
errorCases.expectedError: Please enter a valid 10-digit mobile number

errorCases.name: Consent not accepted
errorCases.expectedError: Please accept the terms and conditions to proceed

errorCases.name: Wrong OTP
errorCases.expectedError: Failed to verify OTP. Please try again.

errorCases.name: Unserviceable pincode
errorCases.expectedError: Sorry, we're not serviceable in this area

errorCases.name: Invalid PAN — manual entry
errorCases.expectedError: Please enter a valid and active PAN number.

errorCases.name: Invalid PAN — validation failure
errorCases.expectedError: The PAN number you entered is not correct. Please enter a valid PAN.

errorCases.name: Session expired — missing token
errorCases.expectedError: Redirect to landing or auth entry
